title: The Meeting Before the Meeting
description: Prep for an important meeting: what matters, what you need to know, what to ask, what could derail it and what decision should actually get made.
promise: Prepare for an important meeting before you walk into it.
what_it_does: Before you walk in, it helps you figure out:
what_it_does_list: What decision should actually get made
when_to_use: Before a meeting you can't afford to wing.
When there's a decision in the room and nobody has said what it is.
what_to_give_it: Who's in the meeting and what it's supposedly about.
Any agenda, notes, emails or docs you already have.
What you want to walk out with.
what_you_get: A short prep sheet: what matters, what to know, what to ask, what could go sideways.
The decision the meeting should actually make, in one sentence.
